units: hbar=1; omega and g are angular frequencies in the same chosen time unit
reference: untouched arbitrary finite R in the analytic claims; qubit R in executed examples

bath.initial_state: two-mode vacuum, independently supplied model premise
bath.slot_memory: same E retained through all live slots; E traced only at terminal output

slots.order: joint unitary U, then F/P instrument; fail stops, pass receives its specified rotation
slots.failure_state: actual unnormalized SR terminal state, no free reset or replacement

output: direct sum over complete classical records of unnormalized terminal SR density blocks; total trace one
main_distance: one half sum_record trace norm of the difference of terminal SR blocks, before readout

acceptance.warning: state-dependent; not s^2 I and no blanket CPTP normalized acceptance claim

parameter_error_bound: D_full <= min(1,(51/10)*abs(lambda-lambda_hat)), both parameters in the frozen interval
truncation: true product-Fock Galerkin P_K H P_K with n1,n2<=K; no physical input filter is assumed
not_claimed: general Gaussian initial states in executed certificate
